svg.title: The page plan holds unanswered disclosure questions
svg.desc: Keep each disclosure question visibly unanswered in the page plan. Do not fill the list with symbolic guilty parties or implied affirmative answers.

Do not fill the list with symbolic guilty parties or implied affirmative answers.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-curt-home-office", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.480048, 0.0962, 0.021504, 0.064512 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WHO INVESTIGATED?", "label_box": [ 0.1792, 0.166712, 0.6232, 0.032847999999999995 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.480048, 0.20756, 0.021504, 0.064512 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WHAT WAS RETAINED?", "label_box": [ 0.1792, 0.278072, 0.6232, 0.032847999999999995 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.480048, 0.31892, 0.021504, 0.064512 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WHO WAS TOLD?", "label_box": [ 0.1792, 0.389432, 0.6232, 0.032847999999999995 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.480048, 0.43028, 0.021504, 0.064512 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WHO COULD REVIEW?", "label_box": [ 0.1792, 0.500792, 0.6232, 0.032847999999999995 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.480048, 0.54164, 0.021504, 0.064512 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WHY NO PUBLIC ACCOUNT?", "label_box": [ 0.1792, 0.612152, 0.6232, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "stack", "source": "
**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Curt writes a column of questions on the page plan, each ending in a question mark, none answered: who investigated the wiki; what was retained; which teams were told; whether a cross-workload review happened; whether the case was available to the independent reviewers; why the September researchers found no specific public account.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> These are not accusations. They are the questions an account would have answered.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — creator action; the questions are the project's and are drawn from the proposal's disclosure analysis. No answer is implied.

", "title": "The page plan holds unanswered disclosure questions" } }
